stem.text: A hinged trapdoor is held closed in the horizontal position by a cable.
Three forces act on the trapdoor: the weight $W$ of the door, the tension $T$ in the cable and the force $H$ at the hinge.

stem.alt: Hinged trapdoor fixed at a hinge on a vertical wall, held by a cable running from the wall to the door. Force arrows labelled T (along the cable), H (at the hinge) and W (downwards on the door). Labels: wall, hinge, cable, trapdoor.

stem.text: Which list gives the three forces in **increasing** order of magnitude?
